Audumbararṣi
pupil of Nimbārka.
--Audumbarī Saṁhitā or Vratapañcakanirṇaya or Rāgavihiṁsanavratanirṇaya.

Audumbarāyaṇa
philosopher of language q. by Yāska in his Nirukta (
), an. ref. to by Bhartṛhari in Vākyapadīya
. On his theory of language see BSOAS. XIV. p.. 73 ff.

Audumbarīsaṃhitā
also called vratapaJcakanirNaya an. rAgavihiMsanavratanirNaya vaiṣ. Nimbārka school. compiled chiefly from Purāṇas by Udumbara Ṛṣi, pupil of Nimbārka. AS. p. 34.
. Rep. Raj. & C. I. p. 37. Sūcīpattra 33.
